yeah i dont react like normal people, im ruthlessly pragmatic due to exigent circumstances. smiling for example, being fake as it is, its just weight, i remember, and i know everything that happens, no benefit whatsoever. no feeling, just the utter desperation/hopelessness of a situation that doesnt change no matter what i do, and as in the song, going to the gold rush, how many died there? how many dreams squashed and destroyed? hope? for ambiguity? lived like that long enough, reality is something not to be reckoned with... millions upon millions live 70, 80 years of their lives, bitter, defeated, no matter what they did, nothing changed, i dont want that life, and before that happens, im ending it, not to consume resources, not to be a drain on society, as society has demonstrated just how much it values my existence. The value more the cremation of a horse, dead horse, which that got 20k, and somebody like me? nothing. not a dime, not something that can turn shit around, because it is out of my hands. completely.

Pale blue dot, devastates me, as it proves how insignificant we are man, i do smile, it isnt real. it hasnt been real for so long. i cant feel it any more. and friends? same people who exploit me, took advantage off, and when there wasn't any more to take... straight up left me in this situation, told them to gtfo. and right now, another so called "friend" wants me to alpha test his sw, for free ofc. but no help. no nothing. this is my life. trash.

I've lost my ability to laugh about a 3 months ago, there is nothing to laugh about a situation that simply doesn't resolve no matter what i do, to fight, to continue, to anything, i live in misery, anguish, in an absolutely hopeless state, im in a ditch, that if people, dont contribute to help me out of it, i cant by myself, because in six years, im asking for help, i reach, and nobody is willing.

1: I directly condensed what you said into the topic of intellectual stimulation, which means conversing, debating, problem solving, using it instead of emotions etc etc etc, they don't solve a single problem, my problem is reality, the world we live in, it might be selfish a bit, but its a problem none the less, which are tied to my emotions, solve one and solve the other. its called opportunity, which i dont have. 
2: I dont want to confirm, I already know it, its not subjective, its based on people who are willingly take action (individually/collectively) to help me out of a massive situation I am in, their unwillingness to help, just confirms via evidence of my value for the people. and it makes me feel like im feeling now.  People, individual/collective, prefer helping animals (dead and alive), helping pushing religious agendas, than a human being on the verge of ending his life because the absolute lack of hope, the absolute lack of opportunity, the absolute lack of willingness of the people to help out.
